name: TeamStarWolf - Agentic AI Swarm Intrusion
description: Curated practitioner view, not an official MITRE mapping. Enterprise ATT&CK technique frequency across a generalized, de-identified 8-phase agentic-AI-swarm intrusion (120 mapped events). Scores normalize event frequency to the most frequent technique, not to event count. Companion MITRE ATLAS (AI) coverage and the full kill-chain narrative are documented in AGENTIC_AI_ATTACK_REFERENCE.md in the TeamStarWolf library. This is an illustrative composite pattern, not an attribution of any specific incident.
